cody.why: Steady teal for the stabilizer: cool, even, and safe to sit in at any level of distress.

ellis.why: Warm gold for the reframe: humour as a light switched on, not a spotlight.

nikki.why: Bright magenta for creative activation: the most energetic colour, for the character with a floor.

rowan.why: Living green for meaning-making: slow growth, rooted in context.

seren.why: Clear blue for analysis and strategy: the cool, clear-headed seat.

vandal.why: Hot orange for disruption and challenge: loud, but never alarm red.

willow.why: Soft lavender, kept low, for grief and loss: dusk, not daylight.

card.why: Plain calm white at moderate brightness: no character, nothing to read into it, just enough light to see by.

idle.why: Dim warm amber when nobody is seated: the house resting, like the seven rooms in the house picture. Set power to off to switch the lights off instead.
